breakdown.description: Output requests solution at T=0.9 but the Domain section specifies t in [0, 0.8].
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt stated 'Compute u(x, T=0.9)' which conflicted with the domain t in [0,0.8]. The generated specification consistently uses T=0.8 throughout: 'The final time for the simulation is T=0.8', 'Compute the numerical solution u(x,t) up to the final time T=0.8', and 'dt = T/Nt to ensure the simulation ends exactly at T=0.8'. This matches the ground truth which specifies T=0.8.
